name: Hand of Iruxos
summary: The Hand of Iruxos is a gruesome artifact that can open demonic portals and close those it has opened. Taiga Wisemane needs it to help banish the portals at Mannoroc Coven.

sections.title: A Gruesome Sight
sections.body: At Shadowprey Village, Taiga Wisemane gives you the Hand of Iruxos and asks you to carry it to Mannoroc Coven. The Burning Blade cultists there have opened portals that bring demons into the world. The hand can close portals it has opened, and Taiga needs its power to stem the growing demon threat.

faq.q: What is the Hand of Iruxos?
faq.answer: It is a grisly relic that opens demonic portals, and can close the ones it opened.

faq.q: Who gives me the Hand of Iruxos?
faq.answer: Taiga Wisemane at Shadowprey Village gives you the Hand of Iruxos and asks you to use it against the portals at Mannoroc Coven.

faq.q: Where do I use the Hand of Iruxos?
faq.answer: Taiga Wisemane asks you to use the Hand of Iruxos to banish demonic portals at Mannoroc Coven.

faq.q: Why are there demons at Mannoroc Coven?
faq.answer: Burning Blade cultists at Mannoroc Coven have opened portals that bring demons into the world.

faq.q: Can the Hand of Iruxos close portals?
faq.answer: The Hand of Iruxos can close demonic portals it has opened.
